1.explanation: To reproduce and fix the broken ComboBox styles you need: 1) ComboBox.js/SCSS to see how the input, clear icon and error icon are rendered and which classes they use. 2) TextInput.js/SCSS to understand the base invalid‐state styling and icon positioning that ComboBox inherits. 3) MultiSelect.js/SCSS because those tag‐list styles are leaking into ComboBox and causing the dark block around the clear icon and misaligned borders.
1.bug_scenario: Both screenshots show that the ComboBox’s text‐input field is picking up MultiSelect styles by mistake. In the error state (first image) the red outline and error icon are shifted inside the input and the helper text sits too low. In the normal/focus state (second image) the clear (×) button is rendered as a dark block that overlaps the dropdown arrow. In short, the ComboBox selection element is being styled like a MultiSelect tag list, and its invalid‐state icon and clear‐button positioning are wrong.
